senses.gloss: m. (טרף, with formative ש, as in טַרְכֵּשׁ; v. P. Sm. 1527 s. v. טרפשתא) a rag-like, irregularly shaped organ, membrane &c.
units: Ḥull. 49ᵇ ט׳ דליבא pericardium with the fat attached to it.—Pl. טַרְפְּשִׁין shreds.
<cite ref="Chullin 46a:11">Ib. 46ᵃ</cite> (in Hebr. dict.) <he>נדלדלה כבד ומעורה בט׳</he> if the liver is detached and disarranged in shreds.
